headline: Is it too late for love, or is this only where I am now?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing showed through the backs, but your hand found the one with nothing put away.
The whole table is open, with every tool still out.
You asked whether it is too late for love or this is only where you are now. The open table catches me.
Love has not come, and “too late” is one of the answers you are considering.
Something turns up just where an open possibility would become love. I don't think it started with you.
Now let me look at what's doing this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You reached without seeing him and chose the card where life continues.
Green leaves grow from the wood above the paused figure.
You asked whether the pause has become a closing time. This card makes me look at the living leaves.
Still, you are alone, and the pause feels close to becoming final.
I keep coming back to something between the living pause and connection. I don't think it began with you.
Let me see what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. The cards were face down, yet your hand went to the only one in full sun.
The sky behind him is gold and clear.
You asked whether love is too late. The full light on this card is the part I keep coming back to.
But no one has come, and the present place feels like the end of the road.
Something has hold of the road without changing what is visible. I don't think this began with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of the result…
